==Dialogue==
Issnur Isles:
:''"Yeah, I used to blow stuff up real good, but after a while it just got too easy. I figured I'd come out here and do something more challenging...like hiding from people who want me to do stuff for them!"''

Cliffs of Dohjok:
:''"It shouldn't be too hard to find these [[undead]]. You can smell their rotting stench from the next island!"''

Churrhir Fields and Plains of Jarin:
:''"Ahai there, <[[character]] name>! I specialize in developing cutting edge Sunspear weaponry. Ha! Get it? *ahem* Just wait and see, I've got a few promising projects in the works."''

Consulate Docks:
:''"Spears as one!"

In Venta Cemetery (outpost):
:''"Well, it looks like we are at it again, eh?"''
:{{ask|gold}} '''We need to evacuate the wounded.''' (After completing [[And a Hero Shall Lead Them]].)
::''"I finally figured out how to disarm those blasted [[Sentry Trap|sentry traps]]! When you and [[Koss]] are ready, we can get these folks back to Istan. I had Nerashi make a map of the area. Here, let me show you the locations."''
::{{yes}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the mission if Koss is in the [[party]].)
:::''"We can't start the evacuation without Koss. He's the only one those corsairs will deal with. If he isn't with us, they'll slit our throats and steal our armor."'' (If Koss is not in the party.)
::;{{no|ingame}} We are not ready yet.
:;{{x}} I'll be on my way.
